notes.title: New Release for PC and Mac - Glowfish, 30% off!
notes.notes:
Glowfish is now on PC & Mac on Steam and available at 30% off until October 7th at 10am Pacific Time!

The evil Dr. Urchin has kidnapped Coralline! It’s up to Glowfish to free his lady friend and sea pals everywhere from his clutches in this underwater platform adventure. Unlock 25 Steam achievements as you navigate through 50 maze-filled levels to save Coralline!
